scope: Read-only signature presence only; not a migration application or behavioral check.

select signature, to_regprocedure(signature) is not null as present
from unnest(array[
'public.wallet_reserve_card_auth(uuid,uuid,bigint,text,text)',
'public.marketplace_place_bid_unchecked(uuid,uuid,uuid,bigint)',
'public.rate_limit_hit(text,integer,integer)',
'public.rate_limit_prune()',
'public.claim_ai_runs(integer,integer)',
'public.claim_marketing_generation_jobs(integer)',
'public.loyalty_award_points(uuid,integer,text,text,text,uuid,uuid)',
'public.loyalty_redeem_reward(uuid,uuid,uuid)',
'public.loyalty_cancel_redemption(uuid,uuid)']) signature;
